response.reply: I don't rank 2027 and 2028 because JyotishAI has no reviewed method for ranking periods. The reviewed rules describe context only: none of them has an approved direction, none is tagged with the part of career it speaks to, and there is no approved convention for two periods that carry different indications. An indication not applying in a year is not evidence against that year. Choose a year to see its full answer, or ask what would allow a ranking.

A ranking would need all of the following, and none of them is in place today. First, an independent Jyotish reviewer approves, for each rule, whether its stated result has a direction or is context only. Second, the reviewer tags each rule with the part of career it speaks to, such as opportunity, stability, income, or recognition, so that any ranking is made for one part at a time and never overall. Third, a reviewed, source-backed convention says what to do when two periods carry different indications. Fourth, the reviewer signs off on the method with worked test cases. Even then, matches would never be added up or counted to decide between periods.
